description: Check whether a paid recommend or inspect answer has settled on-chain. Free, read-only, and never repeats the paid request. Use it after a paid call, with the payment_attempt_id that call returned; answers arrive before settlement completes. Returns data.state (pending, settled, settle_failed_after_answer or settle_unknown_after_answer) and data.transaction (transaction hash once settled, else null). An unknown id returns a not-found error. Pending or unavailable does not prove that no money moved: check the wallet before paying again.

payment_attempt_id.description: The payment_attempt_id returned by a paid recommend or inspect call: a lowercase UUIDv7. Copy it unchanged.

name: receipt
title: Check payment settlement
